claim_scope: CPU score-surface headroom audit only; no deployable method or physical latency claim
research_question: Under a page-level VLM construction budget, can a persistent subset of visual retrieval representations recover substantial full-hybrid gain over an all-page text index, and is that value larger than a non-persistent query-scoped visual baseline?

sensitivity_fusion.name: selected_set_zscore_sum
sensitivity_fusion.semantics: z-score all-page text scores per query; z-score visual scores only across materialized pages and add them only to those pages

selection_policies.corpus_uniform: even coverage over stable corpus order
selection_policies.text_risk: lowest text posting bytes; if unavailable, lowest historical BM25 Top-100 visibility
selection_policies.history_frequency: history-query BM25 Top-100 discounted access frequency
selection_policies.cover25_frequency75: reserve 25% of the page budget for text-risk coverage, then spend the rest on historical discounted frequency
selection_policies.score_oracle: future-query Full visual Top-100 discounted frequency; pays forbidden Full information and is not deployable
selection_policies.label_rank_oracle: future qrels and Full text/visual ranks; optimistic non-deployable headroom heuristic and not an exact combinatorial optimum

gain_recovery: (Q_partial - Q_text) / (Q_full_hybrid - Q_text); omit when absolute denominator < 0.005 and always print denominator sign

online_trace.nonpersistent_baseline: For each query, visually rescore only current BM25 Top-20 and discard; a retrieval-score proxy for DVI-style deferred processing, not a faithful VLM-QA reproduction.
online_trace.persistent_baseline: Materialize current BM25 Top-20 visual retrieval representations before serving, retain them, and expose the cumulative visual subset to future queries.

audit_gate.realizable_policy_requirement: At least one cheap policy must beat random and corpus-uniform while recovering a non-trivial fraction of oracle gain.
audit_gate.persistence_requirement: Persistent materialization must show repeated-page reuse and lower cumulative visual page construction events than the non-persistent proxy.

information_boundary.warning: All three domains were opened by earlier ReprForge work. Results are exploratory headroom evidence, not sealed paper evaluation.
information_boundary.physical_warning: Existing complete score surfaces simulate missing representations. A final method must not build or inspect visual representations for unmaterialized pages.
